<section class="panel" aria-labelledby="automations-title">
  <h1 id="automations-title">Automations for Release board</h1>
  <p>Tag rules and SLA timers run for every post on this board. Only the board's creator and administrators can change them.</p>

  <h2 id="tag-rules-title">Auto-assign by tag</h2>
  <p>When a post gains one of these tags while it has no owner, the post is assigned automatically. Rules never override an existing assignment.</p>

    <p>No tag rules yet.</p>

  <form class="board-post__form" action="/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/tag_assignments" accept-charset="UTF-8" method="post"><input type="hidden" name="authenticity_token" value="post:/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/tag_assignments" />
    <label>
      <span>Tag</span>
      <input autocomplete="off" placeholder="bug" maxlength="30" required="required" size="30" type="text" name="tag" id="tag" />
    </label>
    <label>
      <span>Assign to</span>
      <select required="required" name="assignee_id" id="assignee_id"><option value="">Choose a member</option>
<option value="394959859">Bender Bot</option>
<option value="127326141">David</option>
<option value="149087659">Jason</option></select>
    </label>
    <input type="submit" name="commit" value="Add rule" class="btn btn--reversed" data-disable-with="Add rule" />
</form>
  <h2 id="sla-rules-title">SLA timers</h2>
  <p>A post sitting in a status past the nudge time notifies its owner; past the escalation time it escalates to the board's creator. Each fires once per status change. Leave both blank to disable a status.</p>

  <form action="/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/sla_rules" accept-charset="UTF-8" method="post"><input type="hidden" name="_method" value="patch" /><input type="hidden" name="authenticity_token" value="patch:/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/sla_rules" />
    <table>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th scope="col">Status</th>
          <th scope="col">Nudge after (minutes)</th>
          <th scope="col">Escalate after (minutes)</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
          <tr>
            <th scope="row">Planned</th>
            <td><input min="1" max="43200" aria-label="planned nudge minutes" type="number" name="sla_rules[planned][nudge_after_minutes]" id="sla_rules[planned][nudge_after_minutes]" /></td>
            <td><input min="1" max="43200" aria-label="planned escalation minutes" type="number" name="sla_rules[planned][escalate_after_minutes]" id="sla_rules[planned][escalate_after_minutes]" /></td>
          </tr>
          <tr>
            <th scope="row">In progress</th>
            <td><input min="1" max="43200" aria-label="in_progress nudge minutes" type="number" name="sla_rules[in_progress][nudge_after_minutes]" id="sla_rules[in_progress][nudge_after_minutes]" /></td>
            <td><input min="1" max="43200" aria-label="in_progress escalation minutes" type="number" name="sla_rules[in_progress][escalate_after_minutes]" id="sla_rules[in_progress][escalate_after_minutes]" /></td>
          </tr>
          <tr>
            <th scope="row">Blocked</th>
            <td><input min="1" max="43200" aria-label="blocked nudge minutes" type="number" name="sla_rules[blocked][nudge_after_minutes]" id="sla_rules[blocked][nudge_after_minutes]" /></td>
            <td><input min="1" max="43200" aria-label="blocked escalation minutes" type="number" name="sla_rules[blocked][escalate_after_minutes]" id="sla_rules[blocked][escalate_after_minutes]" /></td>
          </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
    <input type="submit" name="commit" value="Save SLA timers" class="btn btn--reversed" data-disable-with="Save SLA timers" />
</form>
  <h2>Stale-work digest</h2>
  <p>Every day the board posts one quiet digest of the posts sitting past their nudge time. No configuration needed.</p>

<section class="panel" aria-labelledby="automations-title">
  <h1 id="automations-title">Automations for Release board</h1>
  <p>Tag rules and SLA timers run for every post on this board. Only the board's creator and administrators can change them.</p>

  <h2 id="tag-rules-title">Auto-assign by tag</h2>
  <p>When a post gains one of these tags while it has no owner, the post is assigned automatically. Rules never override an existing assignment.</p>

  <h2 id="sla-rules-title">SLA timers</h2>
  <p>A post sitting in a status past the nudge time notifies its owner; past the escalation time it escalates to the board's creator. Each fires once per status change. Leave both blank to disable a status.</p>

  <form action="/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/sla_rules" accept-charset="UTF-8" method="post"><input type="hidden" name="_method" value="patch" /><input type="hidden" name="authenticity_token" value="patch:/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/sla_rules" />

<section class="panel" aria-labelledby="automations-title">
  <h1 id="automations-title">Automations for Release board</h1>
  <p>Tag rules and SLA timers run for every post on this board. Only the board's creator and administrators can change them.</p>

  <h2 id="tag-rules-title">Auto-assign by tag</h2>
  <p>When a post gains one of these tags while it has no owner, the post is assigned automatically. Rules never override an existing assignment.</p>

    <p>No tag rules yet.</p>

  <form class="board-post__form" action="/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/tag_assignments" accept-charset="UTF-8" method="post"><input type="hidden" name="authenticity_token" value="post:/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/tag_assignments" />
    <label>
      <span>Tag</span>
      <input autocomplete="off" placeholder="bug" maxlength="30" required="required" size="30" type="text" name="tag" id="tag" />
    </label>

      <span>Assign to</span>
      <select required="required" name="assignee_id" id="assignee_id"><option value="">Choose a member</option>
<option value="394959859">Bender Bot</option>
<option value="127326141">David</option>
<option value="149087659">Jason</option></select>
    </label>
    <input type="submit" name="commit" value="Add rule" class="btn btn--reversed" data-disable-with="Add rule" />
</form>
  <h2 id="sla-rules-title">SLA timers</h2>
  <p>A post sitting in a status past the nudge time notifies its owner; past the escalation time it escalates to the board's creator. Each fires once per status change. Leave both blank to disable a status.</p>

  <form action="/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/sla_rules" accept-charset="UTF-8" method="post"><input type="hidden" name="_method" value="patch" /><input type="hidden" name="authenticity_token" value="patch:/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/sla_rules" />
    <table>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th scope="col">Status</th>
          <th scope="col">Nudge after (minutes)</th>
          <th scope="col">Escalate after (minutes)</th>

      </thead>

            <td><input min="1" max="43200" aria-label="planned nudge minutes" type="number" name="sla_rules[planned][nudge_after_minutes]" id="sla_rules[planned][nudge_after_minutes]" /></td>

          <tr>

            <td><input min="1" max="43200" aria-label="in_progress nudge minutes" type="number" name="sla_rules[in_progress][nudge_after_minutes]" id="sla_rules[in_progress][nudge_after_minutes]" /></td>
            <td><input min="1" max="43200" aria-label="in_progress escalation minutes" type="number" name="sla_rules[in_progress][escalate_after_minutes]" id="sla_rules[in_progress][escalate_after_minutes]" /></td>
          </tr>
          <tr>
            <th scope="row">Blocked</th>
            <td><input min="1" max="43200" aria-label="blocked nudge minutes" type="number" name="sla_rules[blocked][nudge_after_minutes]" id="sla_rules[blocked][nudge_after_minutes]" /></td>
            <td><input min="1" max="43200" aria-label="blocked escalation minutes" type="number" name="sla_rules[blocked][escalate_after_minutes]" id="sla_rules[blocked][escalate_after_minutes]" /></td>
          </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
    <input type="submit" name="commit" value="Save SLA timers" class="btn btn--reversed" data-disable-with="Save SLA timers" />
</form>
  <h2>Stale-work digest</h2>
  <p>Every day the board posts one quiet digest of the posts sitting past their nudge time. No configuration needed.</p>

  <h1 id="automations-title">Automations for Release board</h1>
  <p>Tag rules and SLA timers run for every post on this board. Only the board's creator and administrators can change them.</p>

  <h2 id="tag-rules-title">Auto-assign by tag</h2>
  <p>When a post gains one of these tags while it has no owner, the post is assigned automatically. Rules never override an existing assignment.</p>

    <p>No tag rules yet.</p>

  <form class="board-post__form" action="/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/tag_assignments" accept-charset="UTF-8" method="post"><input type="hidden" name="authenticity_token" value="post:/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/tag_assignments" />

</form>
  <h2 id="sla-rules-title">SLA timers</h2>
  <p>A post sitting in a status past the nudge time notifies its owner; past the escalation time it escalates to the board's creator. Each fires once per status change. Leave both blank to disable a status.</p>

<section class="panel" aria-labelledby="automations-title">
  <h1 id="automations-title">Automations for Release board</h1>
  <p>Tag rules and SLA timers run for every post on this board. Only the board's creator and administrators can change them.</p>

  <h2 id="tag-rules-title">Auto-assign by tag</h2>
  <p>When a post gains one of these tags while it has no owner, the post is assigned automatically. Rules never override an existing assignment.</p>

    <p>No tag rules yet.</p>

  <form class="board-post__form" action="/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/tag_assignments" accept-charset="UTF-8" method="post"><input type="hidden" name="authenticity_token" value="post:/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/tag_assignments" />
    <label>
      <span>Tag</span>
      <input autocomplete="off" placeholder="bug" maxlength="30" required="required" size="30" type="text" name="tag" id="tag" />
    </label>
    <label>
      <span>Assign to</span>
      <select required="required" name="assignee_id" id="assignee_id"><option value="">Choose a member</option>
<option value="394959859">Bender Bot</option>
<option value="127326141">David</option>
<option value="149087659">Jason</option></select>
    </label>
    <input type="submit" name="commit" value="Add rule" class="btn btn--reversed" data-disable-with="Add rule" />
</form>
  <h2 id="sla-rules-title">SLA timers</h2>
  <p>A post sitting in a status past the nudge time notifies its owner; past the escalation time it escalates to the board's creator. Each fires once per status change. Leave both blank to disable a status.</p>

  <form action="/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/sla_rules" accept-charset="UTF-8" method="post"><input type="hidden" name="_method" value="patch" /><input type="hidden" name="authenticity_token" value="patch:/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/sla_rules" />
      <p class="form-error" role="alert">Planned: Nudge after minutes must be less than or equal to 43200 and Escalate after minutes must be after the nudge threshold</p>
    <table>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th scope="col">Status</th>
          <th scope="col">Nudge after (minutes)</th>
          <th scope="col">Escalate after (minutes)</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
          <tr>
            <th scope="row">Planned</th>
            <td><input value="" min="1" max="43200" aria-label="planned nudge minutes" type="number" name="sla_rules[planned][nudge_after_minutes]" id="sla_rules[planned][nudge_after_minutes]" /></td>
            <td><input value="240" min="1" max="43200" aria-label="planned escalation minutes" type="number" name="sla_rules[planned][escalate_after_minutes]" id="sla_rules[planned][escalate_after_minutes]" /></td>
          </tr>
          <tr>
            <th scope="row">In progress</th>
            <td><input min="1" max="43200" aria-label="in_progress nudge minutes" type="number" name="sla_rules[in_progress][nudge_after_minutes]" id="sla_rules[in_progress][nudge_after_minutes]" /></td>
            <td><input min="1" max="43200" aria-label="in_progress escalation minutes" type="number" name="sla_rules[in_progress][escalate_after_minutes]" id="sla_rules[in_progress][escalate_after_minutes]" /></td>
          </tr>
          <tr>
            <th scope="row">Blocked</th>
            <td><input min="1" max="43200" aria-label="blocked nudge minutes" type="number" name="sla_rules[blocked][nudge_after_minutes]" id="sla_rules[blocked][nudge_after_minutes]" /></td>
            <td><input min="1" max="43200" aria-label="blocked escalation minutes" type="number" name="sla_rules[blocked][escalate_after_minutes]" id="sla_rules[blocked][escalate_after_minutes]" /></td>
          </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
    <input type="submit" name="commit" value="Save SLA timers" class="btn btn--reversed" data-disable-with="Save SLA timers" />
</form>
  <h2>Stale-work digest</h2>
  <p>Every day the board posts one quiet digest of the posts sitting past their nudge time. No configuration needed.</p>

        </dl>
      </section>

      <section aria-labelledby="shortcuts-composer-title">

        <dl>
          <div><dt><kbd>Enter</kbd></dt><dd>Send message</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Shift</kbd> <kbd>Enter</kbd></dt><dd>New line</dd></div>

<section class="panel" aria-labelledby="automations-title">
  <h1 id="automations-title">Automations for Release board</h1>
  <p>Tag rules and SLA timers run for every post on this board. Only the board's creator and administrators can change them.</p>

  <h2 id="tag-rules-title">Auto-assign by tag</h2>
  <p>When a post gains one of these tags while it has no owner, the post is assigned automatically. Rules never override an existing assignment.</p>

    <p>No tag rules yet.</p>

  <form class="board-post__form" action="/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/tag_assignments" accept-charset="UTF-8" method="post"><input type="hidden" name="authenticity_token" value="post:/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/tag_assignments" />
    <label>
      <span>Tag</span>
      <input autocomplete="off" placeholder="bug" maxlength="30" required="required" size="30" type="text" name="tag" id="tag" />

      <span>Assign to</span>
      <select required="required" name="assignee_id" id="assignee_id"><option value="">Choose a member</option>
<option value="394959859">Bender Bot</option>
<option value="127326141">David</option>
<option value="149087659">Jason</option></select>

    <input type="submit" name="commit" value="Add rule" class="btn btn--reversed" data-disable-with="Add rule" />
</form>
  <h2 id="sla-rules-title">SLA timers</h2>
  <p>A post sitting in a status past the nudge time notifies its owner; past the escalation time it escalates to the board's creator. Each fires once per status change. Leave both blank to disable a status.</p>

  <form action="/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/sla_rules" accept-charset="UTF-8" method="post"><input type="hidden" name="_method" value="patch" /><input type="hidden" name="authenticity_token" value="patch:/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/sla_rules" />

  <h1 id="automations-title">Automations for Release board</h1>
  <p>Tag rules and SLA timers run for every post on this board. Only the board's creator and administrators can change them.</p>

  <h2 id="tag-rules-title">Auto-assign by tag</h2>
  <p>When a post gains one of these tags while it has no owner, the post is assigned automatically. Rules never override an existing assignment.</p>

    <p>No tag rules yet.</p>

  <form class="board-post__form" action="/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/tag_assignments" accept-charset="UTF-8" method="post"><input type="hidden" name="authenticity_token" value="post:/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/tag_assignments" />

</form>
  <h2 id="sla-rules-title">SLA timers</h2>
  <p>A post sitting in a status past the nudge time notifies its owner; past the escalation time it escalates to the board's creator. Each fires once per status change. Leave both blank to disable a status.</p>

  <form action="/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/sla_rules" accept-charset="UTF-8" method="post"><input type="hidden" name="_method" value="patch" /><input type="hidden" name="authenticity_token" value="patch:/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/sla_rules" />

<section class="panel" aria-labelledby="automations-title">
  <h1 id="automations-title">Automations for Release board</h1>
  <p>Tag rules and SLA timers run for every post on this board. Only the board's creator and administrators can change them.</p>

  <h2 id="tag-rules-title">Auto-assign by tag</h2>
  <p>When a post gains one of these tags while it has no owner, the post is assigned automatically. Rules never override an existing assignment.</p>

    <p>No tag rules yet.</p>

  <form class="board-post__form" action="/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/tag_assignments" accept-charset="UTF-8" method="post"><input type="hidden" name="authenticity_token" value="post:/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/tag_assignments" />
    <label>
      <span>Tag</span>
      <input autocomplete="off" placeholder="bug" maxlength="30" required="required" size="30" type="text" name="tag" id="tag" />
    </label>
    <label>
      <span>Assign to</span>
      <select required="required" name="assignee_id" id="assignee_id"><option value="">Choose a member</option>
<option value="394959859">Bender Bot</option>
<option value="127326141">David</option>
<option value="149087659">Jason</option></select>
    </label>
    <input type="submit" name="commit" value="Add rule" class="btn btn--reversed" data-disable-with="Add rule" />
</form>
  <h2 id="sla-rules-title">SLA timers</h2>
  <p>A post sitting in a status past the nudge time notifies its owner; past the escalation time it escalates to the board's creator. Each fires once per status change. Leave both blank to disable a status.</p>

  <form action="/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/sla_rules" accept-charset="UTF-8" method="post"><input type="hidden" name="_method" value="patch" /><input type="hidden" name="authenticity_token" value="patch:/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/sla_rules" />
      <p class="form-error" role="alert">Planned: Nudge after minutes must be an integer and Escalate after minutes must be after the nudge threshold</p>
    <table>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th scope="col">Status</th>
          <th scope="col">Nudge after (minutes)</th>
          <th scope="col">Escalate after (minutes)</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
          <tr>
            <th scope="row">Planned</th>
            <td><input value="42" min="1" max="43200" aria-label="planned nudge minutes" type="number" name="sla_rules[planned][nudge_after_minutes]" id="sla_rules[planned][nudge_after_minutes]" /></td>

          </tr>
          <tr>
            <th scope="row">In progress</th>
            <td><input min="1" max="43200" aria-label="in_progress nudge minutes" type="number" name="sla_rules[in_progress][nudge_after_minutes]" id="sla_rules[in_progress][nudge_after_minutes]" /></td>
            <td><input min="1" max="43200" aria-label="in_progress escalation minutes" type="number" name="sla_rules[in_progress][escalate_after_minutes]" id="sla_rules[in_progress][escalate_after_minutes]" /></td>
          </tr>
          <tr>
            <th scope="row">Blocked</th>
            <td><input min="1" max="43200" aria-label="blocked nudge minutes" type="number" name="sla_rules[blocked][nudge_after_minutes]" id="sla_rules[blocked][nudge_after_minutes]" /></td>
            <td><input min="1" max="43200" aria-label="blocked escalation minutes" type="number" name="sla_rules[blocked][escalate_after_minutes]" id="sla_rules[blocked][escalate_after_minutes]" /></td>

    </table>
    <input type="submit" name="commit" value="Save SLA timers" class="btn btn--reversed" data-disable-with="Save SLA timers" />
</form>
  <h2>Stale-work digest</h2>
  <p>Every day the board posts one quiet digest of the posts sitting past their nudge time. No configuration needed.</p>

<section class="panel" aria-labelledby="automations-title">
  <h1 id="automations-title">Automations for Release board</h1>
  <p>Tag rules and SLA timers run for every post on this board. Only the board's creator and administrators can change them.</p>

  <h2 id="tag-rules-title">Auto-assign by tag</h2>
  <p>When a post gains one of these tags while it has no owner, the post is assigned automatically. Rules never override an existing assignment.</p>

    </ul>

  <h2 id="sla-rules-title">SLA timers</h2>
  <p>A post sitting in a status past the nudge time notifies its owner; past the escalation time it escalates to the board's creator. Each fires once per status change. Leave both blank to disable a status.</p>

  <form action="/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/sla_rules" accept-charset="UTF-8" method="post"><input type="hidden" name="_method" value="patch" /><input type="hidden" name="authenticity_token" value="patch:/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/sla_rules" />

<section class="panel" aria-labelledby="automations-title">
  <h1 id="automations-title">Automations for Release board</h1>
  <p>Tag rules and SLA timers run for every post on this board. Only the board's creator and administrators can change them.</p>

  <h2 id="tag-rules-title">Auto-assign by tag</h2>
  <p>When a post gains one of these tags while it has no owner, the post is assigned automatically. Rules never override an existing assignment.</p>

  <h2 id="sla-rules-title">SLA timers</h2>
  <p>A post sitting in a status past the nudge time notifies its owner; past the escalation time it escalates to the board's creator. Each fires once per status change. Leave both blank to disable a status.</p>

  <form action="/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/sla_rules" accept-charset="UTF-8" method="post"><input type="hidden" name="_method" value="patch" /><input type="hidden" name="authenticity_token" value="patch:/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/sla_rules" />

  <h1 id="automations-title">Automations for Release board</h1>
  <p>Tag rules and SLA timers run for every post on this board. Only the board's creator and administrators can change them.</p>

  <h2 id="tag-rules-title">Auto-assign by tag</h2>
  <p>When a post gains one of these tags while it has no owner, the post is assigned automatically. Rules never override an existing assignment.</p>

    <p>No tag rules yet.</p>

  <h2 id="sla-rules-title">SLA timers</h2>
  <p>A post sitting in a status past the nudge time notifies its owner; past the escalation time it escalates to the board's creator. Each fires once per status change. Leave both blank to disable a status.</p>

  <h1 id="automations-title">Automations for Release board</h1>
  <p>Tag rules and SLA timers run for every post on this board. Only the board's creator and administrators can change them.</p>

  <h2 id="tag-rules-title">Auto-assign by tag</h2>
  <p>When a post gains one of these tags while it has no owner, the post is assigned automatically. Rules never override an existing assignment.</p>

    <p>No tag rules yet.</p>

  <h2 id="sla-rules-title">SLA timers</h2>
  <p>A post sitting in a status past the nudge time notifies its owner; past the escalation time it escalates to the board's creator. Each fires once per status change. Leave both blank to disable a status.</p>

  <form action="/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/sla_rules" accept-charset="UTF-8" method="post"><input type="hidden" name="_method" value="patch" /><input type="hidden" name="authenticity_token" value="patch:/rooms/boards/699448332/automations/sla_rules" />

      <dialog id="keyboard-shortcuts" class="shortcuts-sheet" aria-labelledby="shortcuts-title"
        data-keyboard-shortcuts-target="helpDialog"
        data-action="click->keyboard-shortcuts#dismissBackdrop">
  <div class="shortcuts-sheet__surface">
    <header class="shortcuts-sheet__header">
      <h2 id="shortcuts-title">Keyboard shortcuts</h2>
      <form method="dialog">
        <button class="btn shortcuts-sheet__close" aria-label="Close shortcuts">
          <img aria-hidden="true" src="/assets/remove-0e7a045d.svg" width="16" height="16" />
        </button>
      </form>
    </header>

    <div class="shortcuts-sheet__groups">
      <section aria-labelledby="shortcuts-navigate-title">
        <h3 id="shortcuts-navigate-title">Navigate</h3>
        <dl>
          <div><dt><kbd>Ctrl</kbd> <kbd>K</kbd> / <kbd>⌘</kbd> <kbd>K</kbd></dt><dd>Quick switcher</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>/</kbd> or <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> <kbd>Shift</kbd> <kbd>F</kbd> / <kbd>⌘</kbd> <kbd>Shift</kbd> <kbd>F</kbd></dt><dd>Search</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>↑</kbd> / <kbd>↓</kbd> <kbd>Enter</kbd> in search</dt><dd>Pick a recent search</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Alt</kbd> <kbd>↑</kbd> / <kbd>↓</kbd></dt><dd>Previous / next room</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Alt</kbd> <kbd>Shift</kbd> <kbd>↑</kbd> / <kbd>↓</kbd></dt><dd>Previous / next unread room</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Esc</kbd></dt><dd>Mark current room read</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>?</kbd></dt><dd>This help</dd></div>
        </dl>
      </section>

      <section aria-labelledby="shortcuts-sidebar-title">
        <h3 id="shortcuts-sidebar-title">Sidebar rooms</h3>
        <dl>
          <div><dt>Right-click</dt><dd>Room menu (favourites, mute, categories)</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Shift</kbd> <kbd>F10</kbd> or <kbd>☰</kbd></dt><dd>Room menu from the keyboard</dd></div>
        </dl>
      </section>

      <section aria-labelledby="shortcuts-messages-title">
        <h3 id="shortcuts-messages-title">Messages</h3>
        <dl>
          <div><dt><kbd>↑</kbd> / <kbd>↓</kbd></dt><dd>Move between messages</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Home</kbd> / <kbd>End</kbd></dt><dd>First / last message</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Shift</kbd> <kbd>F10</kbd> or <kbd>☰</kbd></dt><dd>Message menu</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>↑</kbd> / <kbd>↓</kbd> in a menu</dt><dd>Move between menu items</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Esc</kbd> in a menu</dt><dd>Close the menu</dd></div>
        </dl>
      </section>

      <section aria-labelledby="shortcuts-composer-title">
        <h3 id="shortcuts-composer-title">Composer</h3>
        <dl>
          <div><dt><kbd>Enter</kbd></dt><dd>Send message</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Shift</kbd> <kbd>Enter</kbd></dt><dd>New line</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>↑</kbd> in an empty composer</dt><dd>Edit your last message</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Ctrl</kbd> <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>⌘</kbd> <kbd>Enter</kbd></dt><dd>Send message</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Ctrl</kbd> <kbd>B</kbd> / <kbd>I</kbd></dt><dd>Bold / italic</dd></div>
        </dl>
      </section>

      <section aria-labelledby="shortcuts-pickers-title">
        <h3 id="shortcuts-pickers-title">Pickers and panels</h3>
        <dl>
          <div><dt><kbd>←</kbd> <kbd>→</kbd> in the emoji picker</dt><dd>Switch emoji tabs</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>↑</kbd> <kbd>↓</kbd> <kbd>Enter</kbd> in the Drive picker</dt><dd>Choose and insert a file</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Esc</kbd></dt><dd>Close members, threads and menus</dd></div>
        </dl>
      </section>
    </div>

    <p class="shortcuts-sheet__note">Shortcuts never fire while typing, unless chorded with <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>, <kbd>⌘</kbd> or <kbd>Alt</kbd>. <kbd>Esc</kbd> closes open dialogs, menus and panels first, and marks the current room read when nothing is open.</p>
  </div>
</dialog>
